item.title: github: GitHub Enterprise Server 3.23 release candidate
item.description:
GitHub Enterprise Server 3.23 is available as a release candidate. The post says it adds new capabilities across the platform and mentions updates to GitHub Projects, but does not provide specifics in the excerpt.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Desktop now supports multiple accounts per host
item.description:
GitHub Desktop now supports signing in with multiple accounts on the same host. This works for GitHub.com, GitHub Enterprise Server, and GHE.com.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Copilot app, Microsoft Ignite releases
item.description:
GitHub released updates for the Copilot app at Microsoft Ignite, adding support for Azure DevOps repositories, GitHub Enterprise Server, and use in the browser. The post says Copilot is intended to work where you already work.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Copilot weekly releases — November 9
item.description:
GitHub Copilot weekly releases for November 9 add support for GitHub Enterprise Server repositories in the Copilot app and a way to identify which agent sessions need attention first in VS Code. The release also includes access to two new models, with the post text truncating after “Claude.”

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Enterprise Server support in the GitHub Copilot app
item.description:
GitHub Copilot app now supports GitHub Enterprise Server accounts. Users can add a GHES account to access remote repositories, issues, and pull requests from the app.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Enterprise Server 3.22 is now generally available
item.description:
GitHub Enterprise Server 3.22 is generally available. The release adds new platform capabilities, including administrator configuration for Copilot CLI.

  • Source: GitHub
